observation: The plugin interface invites vacuous and redundant plugins: kept and interfaces.wildcardModules are one function in TypeScript, Python and Rust; five slots answer what a line declares; NO_SOURCE and NO_INTERFACES fill an empty slot silently; so Rust shipped with every text slot empty and the blind Swift plugin filled two of nine
couldBe: one language model per plugin, its readings derived and a missing one declined with why, prevents both the empty and the repeated slot
a per-reading coverage check over the current slots prevents the empty slot alone, and the repeats remain
discriminatedBy: a blind session writes a Swift plugin against each interface; count the readings proven by its sample project and the patterns it writes twice
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
